chunks.head: pass by
chunks.note: pass by = 从…旁边经过;也可指(时间)流逝。
chunks.ex_en: I pass by the bakery on my way to school every day.
chunks.ex_cn: 我每天上学都会经过那家面包店。

chunks.head: make use of
chunks.note: make use of sth = 加以利用。
chunks.ex_en: We should make use of our free time to read.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们应该利用空闲时间读书。

chunks.head: call attention to
chunks.gloss: 使注意到、引起对…的注意
chunks.note: call attention to sth = 让人注意到某事。
chunks.ex_en: She raised her hand to call attention to the mistake.
chunks.ex_cn: 她举手让大家注意到那个错误。

chunks.head: show off
chunks.note: show off = 显摆、卖弄给别人看。
chunks.ex_en: He likes to show off his new bike.
chunks.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: in order to + 动词 = 表示目的。
chunks.ex_en: She got up early in order to catch the first bus.
chunks.ex_cn: 她早起是为了赶上第一班车。

chunks.head: keep up
chunks.note: keep up = 持续、维持某种状态或行为。
chunks.ex_en: Please keep up the good work.
chunks.ex_cn: 请继续保持,做得好。

chunks.head: in the midst of
chunks.note: in the midst of sth = 正处于某事进行中。
chunks.ex_en: The phone rang in the midst of dinner.
chunks.ex_cn: 正吃饭时电话响了。

chunks.head: light up
chunks.note: one's face lights up = 因高兴而容光焕发。
chunks.ex_en: Her face lit up when she saw the gift.
chunks.ex_cn: 她看到礼物时脸上顿时容光焕发。

chunks.head: right away
chunks.note: right away = 立即,同 at once。
chunks.ex_en: Come home right away.
chunks.ex_cn: 马上回家。

chunks.head: pick up
chunks.note: pick up = 把东西从地上或桌上拿起。
chunks.ex_en: He bent down to pick up the pen.
chunks.ex_cn: 他弯腰捡起那支笔。

chunks.head: be aware of
chunks.note: be aware of sth = 知道、留意到某事。
chunks.ex_en: Be aware of the cars when you cross the road.
chunks.ex_cn: 过马路时要留意来往的车。

chunks.head: hang about
chunks.note: hang about = 在某处逗留、无所事事地待着。
chunks.ex_en: Some boys were hanging about outside the shop.
chunks.ex_cn: 几个男孩在店外闲逛。

chunks.head: in the least
chunks.note: not … in the least = 一点也不,用于否定加强。
chunks.ex_en: I'm not tired in the least.
chunks.ex_cn: 我一点也不累。

chunks.head: say to oneself
chunks.note: say to oneself = 在心里对自己说、暗想。
chunks.ex_en: He said to himself that he could do it.
chunks.ex_cn: 他心里对自己说他能做到。

chunks.head: hold on
chunks.note: hold on = 叫人稍等或停一下。
chunks.ex_en: Hold on, I'll be there in a minute.
chunks.ex_cn: 等一下,我马上就到。

chunks.head: in the wrong
chunks.note: be in the wrong = 做错了、有过错。
chunks.ex_en: You should say sorry when you are in the wrong.
chunks.ex_cn: 你理亏时就该道歉。

chunks.head: now and then
chunks.note: now and then = 不时地,同 from time to time。
chunks.ex_en: We visit our grandparents now and then.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们时不时去看望祖父母。

chunks.head: all at once
chunks.note: all at once = 冷不防地,同 suddenly。
chunks.ex_en: All at once, the lights went out.
chunks.ex_cn: 突然,灯全灭了。

chunks.head: over and over again
chunks.note: over and over again = 反复多次。
chunks.ex_en: She read the letter over and over again.
chunks.ex_cn: 她把那封信读了一遍又一遍。

chunks.head: hold one's peace
chunks.note: hold one's peace = 忍住不说、保持沉默(旧但仍用)。

literal.note_cn: 非'和平'义,此处指不作声

chunks.ex_en: He wanted to argue, but he held his peace.
chunks.ex_cn: 他想争辩,但还是忍住没作声。

chunks.head: think better of it
chunks.gloss: 三思后打消念头、改变主意
chunks.note: think better of it = 再想想后决定不做原打算的事。
chunks.ex_en: I was going to call him, but I thought better of it.
chunks.ex_cn: 我本想给他打电话,后来还是打消了念头。

chunks.head: turn in
chunks.note: turn in = 去睡觉(口语);另有'上交'义,此处指就寝。
chunks.ex_en: It's late; let's turn in.
chunks.ex_cn: 很晚了,咱们睡觉吧。

chunks.head: make a mental note
chunks.note: make a mental note (of/to) = 在心里记下以后要做或注意的事。
chunks.ex_en: I made a mental note to buy milk on the way home.
chunks.ex_cn: 我暗自记下回家路上要买牛奶。

chunks.head: get into trouble
chunks.note: get into trouble = 陷入麻烦;get sb into trouble = 使某人惹上麻烦。本章出处为分离式(getting him into trouble),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: Don't get into trouble at school.
chunks.ex_cn: 别在学校惹麻烦。

chunks.head: under one's nose
chunks.note: (right) under one's nose = 就在眼前却没察觉,或当着某人的面。本章出处被'aunt's very'隔开,故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: The keys were right under my nose the whole time.
chunks.ex_cn: 钥匙一直就在我眼皮底下。

skipped: 方言表层低迁移词块 e.g. 'a body'(=人)、'like enough'、'warn't'、'a mind to'
拟声/一次性喊话 e.g. 'Well, I never!'、'Umf!'
一次性文学/古旧惯用语(读一次即可,不进语块层) e.g. 'sally to the rescue'、'wending her way'、'sick unto death'、'hove/discharging lightnings of wrath'
专有名词 e.g. Aunt Polly, Sid, Joe Harper, Jeff Thatcher, Amy Lawrence
过于基础/语法性 e.g. 'going to'、'full of'、'according to'、'of course'
一次性描写性搭配 e.g. 'cow-stable'、'log raft'、'tallow dip'
